name: 28047-longprefix-granite4tiny-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one engine, one node.
architecture: GraniteMoeHybridForCausalLM, a hybrid SSM: 40 layers, 36 mamba2 and 4 attention; 62 experts with 6 active per token; ~7B parameters, ~1B active per token; bf16; max_position_embeddings 131072. Read off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, rampup_duration 30 s, bounded at 240 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 20% by request count. The 30 s ramp spreads the first eight starts 3.75 s apart rather than admitting eight 65k prompts in one scheduling step; keep the stream count inside 4-16 and raise max_requests with it.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn: 8 unique prefixes of 65,024 tokens, one drawn at random per request and sent as the system message, plus a fresh 512-token user message -- 65,536 declared prompt tokens in, exactly 10 tokens out (min = max, so the backend forces ignore_eos), prefix caching on. The engine re-tokenises the rendered chat template, so its own prompt-token count reads somewhat above 65,536; max-model-len 67584 leaves ~2k of slack.
purpose: A document question-answering service over eight shared 64k-token dossiers, eight concurrent users, brief answers, one GPU.
launch:
# Engine configuration for 28047-longprefix-granite4tiny-1gpu.

model: ibm-granite/granite-4.0-tiny-preview
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
enable-prefix-caching: true
max-model-len: 67584

# Pinned: left unset, this entry point resolves to 2048 / 128, which would cut each
# 65k prompt into 32 prefill chunks instead of 4.
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 1024

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
